secrets.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Credential for the agent's model (callstack/apex, a Vercel AI Gateway model ID). Create one at https://vercel.com/dashboard -> AI Gateway -> API keys. Without it the chat UI loads but agent turns fail.

secrets.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Signing secret for Better Auth sessions. Development mode falls back to a local placeholder; set a real random string before using Vercel sign-in.

secrets.name: VERCEL_APP_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Client ID of a Vercel OAuth app used for the 'Continue with Vercel' sign-in (vercel.com/dashboard -> Settings -> Apps).

secrets.name: VERCEL_APP_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Client secret of the same Vercel OAuth app.
